problem_text:
A logistics company is preparing to dispatch four distinct categories of cargo, each necessitating four sequential handling procedures for full preparation.  
The revenue generated per metric ton for each cargo category is detailed as follows:  
* For Cargo Alpha, revenue is 5.279 per metric ton  
* For Cargo Beta, revenue is 5.61 per metric ton  
* For Cargo Gamma, revenue is 15.215 per metric ton  
* For Cargo Delta, revenue is 13.375 per metric ton  

Handling duration required per metric ton for each procedure is as follows:  
* For Cargo Alpha, Procedure 1 consumes 1.904 (ton-hours), Procedure 2 consumes 1.889 (ton-hours), Procedure 3 consumes 1.838 (ton-hours), Procedure 4 consumes 0.276 (ton-hours)  
* For Cargo Beta, Procedure 1 consumes 1.548 (ton-hours), Procedure 2 consumes 1.462 (ton-hours), Procedure 3 consumes 1.38 (ton-hours), Procedure 4 consumes 1.482 (ton-hours)  
* For Cargo Gamma, Procedure 1 consumes 1.825 (ton-hours), Procedure 2 consumes 1.352 (ton-hours), Procedure 3 consumes 0.87 (ton-hours), Procedure 4 consumes 1.168 (ton-hours)  
* For Cargo Delta, Procedure 1 consumes 0.574 (ton-hours), Procedure 2 consumes 1.257 (ton-hours), Procedure 3 consumes 0.216 (ton-hours), Procedure 4 consumes 0.472 (ton-hours)  

* The cumulative handling time for Procedure 1 must remain within 148.565 hours  
* The cumulative handling time for Procedure 2 must remain within 165.784 hours  
* The cumulative handling time for Procedure 3 must remain within 173.553 hours  
* The cumulative handling time for Procedure 4 must remain within 91.48 hours  

Under the condition that each handling procedure’s total duration does not surpass its allotted time capacity, determine the optimal allocation of metric tons for each cargo category to maximize total revenue.
